svg.title: Layers of the gut wall
svg.desc: Cross-section of the gut wall from the lumen (top) outward: the mucosa of the colon, a flat surface with deep crypts lined by mucus-filled goblet cells, the lamina propria and a thin muscle sheet; the submucosa, with blood vessels and the submucosal plexus; inner circular muscle; the myenteric plexus; outer longitudinal muscle; and the serosa. The two enteric plexuses are drawn in the accent colour.
